DRIPLINE

Dark Blue Earthy Fade Jeans

1

Crafted from lightweight denim, these dark blue jeans feature a fluid texture that moves with ease. The wash is artfully treated using spray and laser techniques, creating a degrade effect at the hem and finished with sandy-toned dirt accents for a lived-in, modern edge.

 

Material & Care

  • 100% Tencel Lyocell lightweight denim

  • Machine wash cold

  • Do not bleach; tumble dry low or hang dry

  • Warm iron on reverse if needed
